snippet.title: TerraLounge Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
From deep caverns to a sky-high lounge, follow along as slimes explore the wide world outside the caves they lived in for so long. Get comfy, and join the slimes on their journey, or let them hang out with you in their terrarium while you work, study, or relax!

Links:
Demo out now on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/5067430/TerraLounge_Demo/ 
Coming Soon on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/5045050/TerraLounge
